verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is the Obsidian Sync headless client, which syncs vaults without the desktop app and is pitched for CI pipelines, agents and automated workflows. That makes it an official non-GUI tool, but its scope is limited to syncing and the evidence never documents it as a general CLI. Obsidian URI and the plugin API are adjacent mechanisms or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose official CLI (note create/read/search/edit commands), an explicit CLI command reference for the headless client, any AI-agent-oriented CLI workflows beyond sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
